name: Camping 101: First Aid
summary: In Kharanos, Thamner Pol teaches you to prepare First Aid Kits for camps in Dun Morogh. With these supplies, travelers can stay alive in the field.

sections.title: Tending Wounds in the Wild
sections.body: You can build on your basic bandaging skills by learning to prepare supplies for a resting site. Thamner Pol shows you how raw medical supplies become complete kits, ready for use at camp when travelers need care far from shelter.

sections.title: The Lessons of Kharanos
sections.body: Thamner Pol teaches you practical ways to outfit expedition sites with emergency supplies. A proper field kit lets a group bind wounds and regain strength together by the hearth before heading back into the cold.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this task?
faq.answer: Newly trained medics go to Thamner Pol in Kharanos to learn how to make First Aid Kits for adventurer campsites.
Thamner Pol trains people in Kharanos, Dun Morogh, to make gear for wilderness camps.

faq.q: Where does this training take place?
faq.answer: The training takes place in Kharanos, the main settlement in central Dun Morogh, south of Ironforge.

faq.q: Why is a camp first aid kit important?
aliases: what does first aid kit do
why make a first aid kit
faq.answer: A camp First Aid Kit gives injured travelers supplies to bind their wounds and recover safely between battles.

faq.q: Do you need prior medical training before seeking Thamner Pol?
aliases: do i need first aid first
faq.answer: Yes. Adventurers should know the basics of First Aid and show some skill before Thamner Pol teaches them advanced camping recipes.

faq.q: Is this pursuit open to any adventurer?
aliases: who can learn camp first aid
faq.answer: Any adventurer can learn First Aid, whatever their calling, making it a useful skill for travelers in Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you rely on sturdy, practical gear while patrolling Dun Morogh's high snowy passes. A camp First Aid Kit is a useful part of your supplies.
As a gnome refugee or wanderer in Kharanos, you can rely on field medicine while surviving beyond Gnomeregan's lost halls.
As an Alliance recruit training in Khaz Modan's frozen heart, you learn that self-sufficiency and field medicine matter to military and exploratory groups.

attribution: In-game quest text: Camping 101: First Aid
